ariyipp links two phones over end-to-end encrypted FCM to relay SMS between them: a companion phone (with the SIM) forwards its incoming SMS to your main device, where you read and reply to them as a chat, and the main device can send SMS back through the companion. Notification capture and webhook posting are optional extras. This device\'s role is shown below, and can be switched anytime.

ariyipp v1.3 - Security hardening. The webhook URL must now be https, both when you set it here and when a webhook config is pushed from the main device; the companion also shows a notification whenever the main device changes its webhook settings, and accepting pushed config is now opt-in (off by default). Encrypted backups use stronger key derivation (600,000 PBKDF2 iterations, up from 120,000) and require a 12-character passphrase; older backups still restore with their original passphrase.

ariyipp v1.2 - Messages: long-press a message to share it to any other installed app (separate from Forward, which relays it as a new SMS through the companion); the chat screen's own menu now has Mute/Unmute and Mark as read too. The Messages list gets a collapsible search bar and a new overflow menu with Mark all as read and multi-select (Select all/Deselect all, Mark as read, Mute, Delete) - long-press a conversation's avatar to jump straight into selection. Predictive back gesture support throughout the app. Status and Messages no longer visibly pop in their content a beat after the tab-switch animation finishes, and Status stops re-checking permissions on every tab switch. Fixed dark mode showing near-black on the chat screen and inside Settings sub-screens, and an overflow menu that blended into its own background; fixed low-contrast incoming message bubbles (plus the date header and compose field) in light mode. Also fixed a couple of smaller Messages-list glitches: a jarring jump when opening/closing search, and the list briefly appearing empty right after.

ariyipp v1.1 - Chat screen redesign: compact bubbles with an inline timestamp, a floating date header, and a jump-to-latest button, grouped by day. Delivery-receipt ticks on sent messages are now real (received by companion / handed to SIM / carrier-confirmed) instead of decorative. Performance pass: chats open by loading only the newest history page, the conversation list updates itself live instead of polling, relayed payloads are smaller over the air, long SMS split reliably, connections are reused instead of re-authenticating on every send, cold start skips crypto work off the main thread, chat history respects a retention setting, and the conversation list/search now stay fast via a dedicated index as history grows. Also a batch of UI bug fixes: bubble line spacing, RTL timestamp placement, a shared-background flicker, and an oversized corner-radius clamp on short messages.

ariyipp v1.0 - Pair two phones over end-to-end encrypted FCM to relay SMS between them. The main device receives the relayed SMS as a searchable chat and can reply; the companion phone (with the SIM) forwards its incoming SMS and sends SMS on request. Pick a role on first run and switch anytime. Optional extras: notification capture to a webhook, encrypted backup and restore, per-conversation mute, and a liveness heartbeat that warns if the other device goes offline. Bring your own Firebase project (BYO-FCM).

On the Status screen, grant SMS access and exempt the app from battery optimization. Without SMS access nothing is relayed; without the battery exemption the system may sleep the app and miss messages.

Open Settings → Pairing. Scan main device\'s code to fill in the main device\'s token and the shared key in one step, or paste them by hand. The shared key is generated on main - the companion only receives it, so both ends always match.

To let main compose messages this phone sends from its SIM: import the FCM service-account key, turn on \"Send SMS on command from main\", and grant SEND_SMS. The first time you send to a short code, Android may ask you to allow it - choose \"Always allow\".
Optionally forward every SMS to a webhook as well. In Settings → Webhook, enable it and enter the URL and auth header. Each message is sent once; duplicates from the missed-SMS sync are suppressed.

\"Sync missed SMS now\" (Status) catches messages that arrived while the app was asleep. \"Repush entire inbox to main\" re-sends every SMS so main can rebuild its history after a gap - main ignores anything it already has.

Settings → Diagnostics logs each relay with the reason when it fails. If main isn\'t receiving: check the shared key matches and main device\'s token is current (re-scan if main was reinstalled), and keep this app battery-unrestricted.
Name each SIM so relayed messages show the carrier without needing phone-state access. Leave blank to use \"SIM 1\" / \"SIM 2\".
